notes.title: Feel-A-Maze has been updated!
notes.content:
From Five Archers:

Hey all, little update, getting ready for big the Christmas Update!
- Major: Controls have been updated!  No more teleporting (if any of you found that little trick...)  But the ball will now stick to the mouse cursor much more closely while dragging.  So while you can't cut corners anymore, you can go a LOT faster in straight sections!
- Music no longer restarts after every retry!  (Also means some longer tracks will be coming out in the future!)
- Fixed the Global Ranking leaderboard receiving zeroes (I'll remove the zero times) (This leaderboard is the total of all your times from the first 40 levels)
- Reversed the "Next/Skip" and "Retry" buttons on the end of level menu - was counterintuitive!

notes.title: Feel-A-Maze now live on Steam
notes.content:
Feel-A-Maze is now live on Steam! A great new twist on the classic maze game! 

Guide your ball through the maze in this quick and addictive arcade game.

Feel-A-Maze is the perfect game to pick up and play when you've only got a few minutes to spare.  Unlock all 40 mazes, Collect 120 Stars, Get All 10 Achievements, Compete with your friends to top the leaderboards!

YOU WILL FEEL-A-MAZE!
